name: Gloamhaven
about: Helheim, the quiet realm of the dead. Gloamhaven is a lantern-lit spirit town on a still black lake: crooked houses with violet windows, the Lantern Bridge, willows hung with glow orbs, and ghosts going about their evenings. Hel's arch south (to Bifrost), Hel's Hall north on its ledge, the Last Hearth Inn west, the ferry steps east (the Lantern Shore), the Archive door north-west.

exits.label: the ferry steps to the Lantern Shore

portals.label: Hel's arch back to Bifrost Crossing

actors.name: Hel
say: Mind your lamp. It's the only one like it here.

actors.name: Corvin Lanternmere
say: A lantern isn't for seeing. It's so you can be seen.

actors.name: Hettie Tallow
say: Sit, sit, love. Soup? No, you can't have it, you're alive. Smell it then.

actors.name: Old Marrow
say: Best crust in Helheim. Only crust in Helheim.

actors.name: A Gloamhaven ghost
say: Mind the road. It wails, but it doesn't bite.
